title: Traffic-Tee Proctoring: credit-aware shadowing with tenant isolation
creator: Aisha Menon
description:
Goal: Implement a production-safe traffic-tee (tee-proctor) subsystem that duplicates a controlled fraction of live requests to probe/validate candidate models without impacting production SLOs or tenant billing. This ticket covers design and an MVP implementation covering: credit-based cost fencing, per-tenant adaptive sampling, I/O and KV-cache warm-up handling for mirrored requests, PII redaction for mirrors, and graceful degradation/backpressure when probe budgets are exhausted.

Why: Current ad-hoc shadowing increases risk of runaway costs and noisy outputs reaching logs. We need a standardized, observable, and tenant-isolating tee that teams can opt into for canary validation, A/B experiments, and offline evals while guaranteeing no charge or latency exposure to customers.

Non-goals: Full traffic replay system, historical replay store, and complex A/B assignment logic (these are separate initiatives). This ticket focuses on safe live duplication and protective controls for running probe traffic in-line with live inference.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Platform can tee up to 10% of requests for a target route with per-tenant sampling rates configurable via Console and API (minimum granularity: route + tenant)

2) Mirrored requests never increase caller-visible latency beyond 2ms p50 overhead when probe path is healthy; when probe path backpressures, tees degrade without affecting main path latency or error budget
3) Credit-based budget: tenants or orgs can set a monthly probe-credit allowance; once exhausted, mirrored traffic is automatically sampled down with audit logs

4) Mirrored requests are scrubbed of sensitive headers and body fields per redaction policy before leaving the production network (configurable field list), with audit flagging for any suppressed fields
5) KV-cache warm-up hints are optionally sent to probe cluster to avoid cold-cache artifacts while ensuring no persistent cache pollution on hosts serving production traffic

6) Per-route divergence metrics emitted (delta-score, token-level entropy difference, top-k token overlap) and integrated into Console dashboards with regression alerting (default threshold configurable)
7) Implementation has an end-to-end test harness that can simulate budget exhaustion and verify no chargebacks to tenants and consistent main-path latency under load
tasks: Design: API schema for per-tenant probe config + Console UI wireframe (PM + Design)
Runtime: Add tee hook in request pipeline with fast path for disabled/passed-through requests
Billing: Integrate probe-credit ledger and usage emission; ensure mirrored tokens are excluded from upstream billing reports
Safety: Implement redaction middleware and privacy rules for mirrored payloads
Backpressure: Build cost-circuit-breaker that steps down sampling on budget signals or probe latency spikes
Observability: Add metrics and traces for tee latency, sample-rate, budget consumption, and divergence signals
Tests: Create load tests demonstrating <2ms overhead and unit tests for redaction and credit behavior
Docs: Public docs for SDK/Console configuration and internal runbook for incident response
